message: Reviewer 1 REQUESTED CHANGES on independent review 9e529ef0943d48eaae9a8fb435b3587e, frozen ffa3aeb. Preserve alias selectors for both rows and summaries; add tests. (2) duplicate aliases are fetched in parallel and first result wins regardless of snapshot head; one refresh can silently discard newer verified Working/unread counts. Dedup before fetch or compare commits/provenance and handle conflicts; test differing heads. Full Client Release 540/540 passed; Server command exit 0, clean patch and conflict-free merge-tree.
